TEAM.TITLE: Team
TEAM.INTRO: Invite your people and give each person a specialty. Whoever signs in as functional sees and handles everything in their specialties right away.
TEAM.NO_NAME: No name: fix it to identify them.
TEAM.LOAD_ERROR: We could not load the team.

INVITE.TITLE: Invite a person
INVITE.NAME: First name
INVITE.EMAIL_TAKEN: There is already a user registered with that email.
INVITE.ALREADY_IN_TEAM: There is already a user registered with that email: {{who}} ({{role}}).
INVITE.ADMIN_HELP: An administrator manages the team and validates what is uploaded, like you. Only another administrator can create one.
INVITE.DIMENSIONS_HELP: A functional person carries out and uploads the evidence of the dimensions they specialize in. Choose at least one.
INVITE.AUDITOR_HELP: An auditor reviews everything in your company read-only and leaves observations; they have no specialties.

CODE.TITLE: Activation code for {{email}}
CODE.BODY: Hand it to the person now: this is the only time you will see it. With it they activate their account and create their password.
CODE.EXPIRES: Expires on {{date}}. If it gets lost, issue a new one.

CONFIRM.DEACTIVATE_BODY: Their session closes immediately and they will not be able to sign in again until you reactivate them. What they already did is kept.
CONFIRM.RESET_MFA_BODY: Their sessions are closed and, on their next sign-in, they will set up the second factor again. Use it only if they lost their phone and their recovery codes.

WORK.INTRO: The owner of a dimension takes charge of every control of the service that has tests in that dimension. If you change the owner, it changes for every control that has no exception.
WORK.NO_SERVICES: You have no services yet. Declare one in “My services” to split its work.
WORK.CONTROLS: {{count}} controls with tests in this dimension
WORK.NO_CANDIDATES: Nobody on the team has this specialty yet.

NOTICE.INVITED: Done, we created the account. Hand over the activation code.
NOTICE.CODE_REISSUED: Done, we issued a new code. The previous one no longer works.
NOTICE.MFA_RESET: Done, we removed the second factor.

ERROR.SAVE: We could not save the change. Please try again.
